text: Try not to yawn while watching this.
For years, people thought yawning was about getting more oxygen.
But when scientists tested it, extra oxygen didn't change how often people yawned.
A newer idea: yawning helps cool your brain, by pulling in air and boosting blood flow to your head.
And yawns are contagious. Seeing, hearing, or even reading about one can set you off.
You catch yawns more easily from friends and family than from strangers.
Even dogs can catch yawns from their owners.
